test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Figure A is related to B in a certain pattern. Following the same pattern, figure C is related to D. Study the pattern and select the figure which should be placed in place of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a87a9880a2e492d6e95c0761991e3944a92e07d106c00332ba89adcce78bd84.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: 1. New element added in middle upper side figure.**

**2. Same symbol is increase by one in middle left and middle right. **

**3. Same symbol is increase by one in bottom left corner and shifted to bottom right corner.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca3fbb0dd00e243acc4a84ce6b4c1f99de99b5e93d098ada6e9a95e8ccba3136.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
